Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

15:6374-1971 

2.1 Tolerances on Width Across f/afs — As specified for forged and subsequently machiried spanners 
in IS : 2027-1 967 ' Widths across flats for spanners ( first revision ) '. 

3. Material — Suitable alloyed and unalloyed steels which fulfil the requirements laid down in 4. 

Suitable Example: 

2TCr1Mo28and 50Cr1V23 of IS : 1570-1961 'Schedules for wrought steels for general 
engineering purposes '. 

4. HardnesSi Workmanship and Finlsfi, Preservation and Packing, Tests and Sampling — 

According to 13:6131-1971 'Technical requirements for hand operated wrenches ( spanners ) and 
sockets '. The torque test shall conform to Series A of IS : 61 31-1 971 . 

5i Designation — A hexagonal box wrench of width across flat of 30 mm shall be designated as: 

Wrench 30, IS : 6374 

6. Marking — Each wrench shall be marked with the nominal width across flats and the manufacturer's 
name, initial or recognized trade-mark. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

While preparing this standard, assistance has been derived from €SN 230630-1963 ' Zavrene klice na 
sestihrany ( Closed-end spanners for hexagons ) 'issued by Urad Pro Norma lizaci a merini.
